tasks.title: Loader --pretty flag + jq-safe default
definition_of_done: load-rfc, load-spike, load-plan, and load-task all default to single-line compact JSON via process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(doc) + '\n'); each loader gains a --pretty flag that opts back into multi-line JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2); tests/cli.test.ts gains 12 new test cases (3 per loader: default-form single-line round-trip, --pretty multi-line round-trip, invalid-args error to stderr with non-zero exit)
acceptance_criteria: cloverleaf-cli load-rfc <repo> <id> stdout is single line ending in \n and parses with JSON.parse
cloverleaf-cli load-rfc <repo> <id> --pretty stdout has multiple lines and parses with JSON.parse
Same defaults and --pretty semantics apply to load-spike / load-plan / load-task
